summary: Tested backend APIs and admin/driver UI flows. Fixed Mongo ObjectId serialization that caused all create POST responses to return HTTP 500. Core routes, ordering, map, reports, product save, auth, and driver navigation passed after fix.

integration_issues.flow: Driver login while reports route is active
integration_issues.issue: Reports component does not catch GET /api/reports 403 for driver; React development runtime overlay shows uncaught AxiosError instead of a graceful restricted/redirected state.

action_items: Handle Reports GET 403/error in the Reports component and redirect or show an access message when a driver session is active.
critical_code_review_comments: create_resource previously returned Mongo-injected _id and caused HTTP 500 serialization failures; fixed by removing _id before response.
Reports route is present in React Router for all roles; hidden sidebar is not sufficient authorization UX because direct/retained route produces an uncaught 403 overlay.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 regression tests; four create endpoint smoke checks passed)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (core admin/driver flows passed; driver retained reports route error)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST CLI2, TEST C2, and one TEST expense via API during testing; created TEST UI Final product through UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login, route map/order, reports KPI/table, product form POST, and driver hidden links passed. Prior to fix all create POSTs failed 500 due _id; fixed and verified. Reproduce remaining issue by admin visiting /relatorios, logout, login as driver: reports GET returns 403 and uncaught AxiosError overlay appears.
rca of the issue: create_resource inserts doc into MongoDB; Motor mutates the same dict with ObjectId _id, and FastAPI cannot JSON encode it. Removing _id before returning resolves POST failures. Reports useEffect calls api.get without catch; after driver login on retained /relatorios route, backend correctly returns 403 but frontend leaves rejected promise uncaught.
